basic_details.job_title: BECIL Social Media Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: BECIL needs 2 Social Media Analysts on contract for deployment in the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, at a consolidated Rs.60,000/- a month. Graduates with at least 2-3 years of post-qualification experience in social media management and digital marketing can apply. Applications are accepted only online, up to 11:59 PM on 13 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online as part of the application. Once paid, it is non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Social Media Analyst Recruitment 2026 Overview

rows.information: Online, through the BECIL registration portal

content_sections.heading: About BECIL
content_sections.text: Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited is a Mini Ratna Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting. Its head office is at 14-B, Ring Road, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002, and its corporate office is at BECIL Bhawan, C-56/A-17, Sector-62, Noida-201307. In this recruitment, BECIL is engaging manpower for its client, the Ministry of Mines.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Social Media Analyst Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on the requirements of the Client/Principal Employer. content_sections.heading: BECIL Social Media Analyst Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Digital Marketing, Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or any other recognized graduate degree from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 2-3 years of post-qualification experience in social media management and digital marketing. Experience in managing official social media platforms such as Facebook, X (Twitter), Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other digital channels. Experience in creating and scheduling social media content, campaign planning and audience engagement. Knowledge of social media analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, etc.) and preparing performance reports. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi. Preference may be given to candidates with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Advertising, or Social Media Management. Experience in graphic design/video editing tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or similar software will be preferred. Knowledge of SEO, SEM, social media trends and digital advertising will be an added advantage. Desirable: experience of handling social media accounts for Government Departments, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, or reputed organizations. Desirable: certification in Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Google Analytics, Meta Blueprint, or equivalent. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Preference may be given to local candidates and/or candidates with relevant experience in the same or similar department, subject to the Client's requirements. Candidates previously engaged by BECIL and/or the Client are not eligible if their services were terminated, discontinued or not renewed because of disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance or violation of contractual terms. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online as part of the application. Once paid, it is non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Late applications will be summarily rejected, and no request to extend the last date will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized and shortlisted against the prescribed eligibility criteria. BECIL may adopt suitable shortlisting criteria, including higher qualifications, greater relevant experience or any other criteria it considers appropriate. The list of shortlisted candidates is forwarded to the Client/Principal Employer. The Client carries out further selection, which may include an interview, assessment, skill test or any other evaluation method it decides. Candidates selected by the Client are informed of their selection and the next formalities by email and/or telephone. Meeting the qualification and experience requirements does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for any stage. Preference may be given for higher qualifications, superior academic credentials, additional relevant experience or other desirable criteria set by the Client. BECIL has no obligation to publish interim results, stage-wise shortlists or marks. Only the final result, listing the candidates selected by the Client, will appear on the BECIL website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis, with deployment in the Ministry of Mines, Government of India. Candidature stays provisional at all stages, subject to verification of original documents on age, qualification, experience, category and other eligibility conditions. If false information or ineligibility comes to light after engagement, the services may be terminated forthwith and legal action may also be initiated. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts at New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Social Media Analyst Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the BECIL registration portal to begin the online registration process. Fill in your personal details under new registration and register. Proceed to the other details, along with all requisite documents specified for the post. Pay the application processing fee, if applicable, to complete the submission. After the online payment succeeds, save the application receipt, and keep a copy of the completed application form. Check every entry before submitting, because no modification, correction or alteration is allowed afterwards. Incomplete applications, or those received without the requisite documents, will be summarily rejected. Original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials, at the time of document verification, interview or personal interaction. A valid Police Verification Report (PVR), at Document Verification after selection.

faq.question: Q1. Can a graduate from any subject apply for the Social Media Analyst post?
faq.answer: Yes, if the degree is from a recognized University/Institute. Along with named subjects such as Journalism and Marketing, the notice accepts any other recognized graduate degree, but the 2-3 years of relevant experience is still required.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a permanent central government job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract basis, and the selected candidates will be deployed in the Ministry of Mines.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: The notice does not fix a written exam. After BECIL shortlists applications, the Client may use an interview, assessment, skill test or another evaluation method.

faq.question: Q4. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: They will receive the date, time and venue or mode through their registered email and/or telephone. BECIL also asks candidates to monitor the Spam/Junk folder of their registered email account.

faq.question: Q5. Do SC/ST and PWD candidates pay a fee?
faq.answer: No, their application processing fee is NIL. Only candidates in all other categories pay the Rs.295/- fee.

faq.question: Q6. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA is not admissible for any test, document verification, interview, personal interaction or skill test, or for joining duties upon selection.

faq.question: Q7. Is police verification required?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected candidate must submit a valid Police Verification Report at Document Verification after selection, and failure to do so makes the selection liable to cancellation.

faq.question: Q8. Can a candidate contact the Ministry of Mines directly about this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must not approach the Client/Principal Employer directly, and canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Queries can go to the BECIL helpdesk on 0120-4177850 / 0120-4177860.

faq.question: Q9. Does BECIL charge anything besides the application fee?
faq.answer: No. BECIL says it does not demand or accept any other payment at any stage and does not use any agent, intermediary or consultant for recruitment. Fraudulent offers may be reported to BECIL.
